title: Tiny, cute pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Left blade -->
  <polygon points="50,50 18,20 22,16" fill="#c0d8e8" stroke="#e8f4ff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- Right blade -->
  <polygon points="50,50 82,20 78,16" fill="#c0d8e8" stroke="#e8f4ff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- Blade edge highlights -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="19" y2="19" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="81" y2="19" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Left handle -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="76" rx="12" ry="15" fill="#ff6b8a" stroke="#ffa0b4" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="76" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#ff8fab"/>
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="76" rx="12" ry="15" fill="#ff6b8a" stroke="#ffa0b4" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="76" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#ff8fab"/>
  <!-- Left handle arm -->
  <line x1="38" y1="62" x2="50" y2="50" stroke="#ff4455" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right handle arm -->
  <line x1="62" y1="62" x2="50" y2="50" stroke="#ff4455" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="4.5" fill="#ffd700" stroke="#ffe866" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2" fill="#ffef99"/>
  <!-- Cute face on pivot -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="49" r="0.9" fill="#7a5800"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="49" r="0.9" fill="#7a5800"/>
  <path d="M49 51 Q50 52.2 51 51" stroke="#7a5800" stroke-width="0.7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
